articles.title: RCMP allege 24-year-old Quebec man researched chemical weapons, planned attack for ISIS
articles.description: RCMP say Louay Angoud allegedly communicated online with members of a terrorist group and gathered information to build a chemical weapon that could be used to poison Canadians.
